source.title: Delegate inadvertently changed time limit for blindfolded round
source.content:
Prior to the start of a round of 3x3 blindfolded, a delegate did a demonstration to competitors showing how blind solving works. During this tutorial, the delegate inadvertently mentioned that the cumulative time limit for the round was *12 minutes* whereas the competition website mentioned that it was *10 minutes*.

This mistake was only realized after the round had commenced. 

One competitor had DNFed their first two attempts but successfully solved their third attempt, but their cumulative time limit was greater than 10 minutes but less than 12 minutes. 

The relevant regulation is A1a3:

> A1a3) The time limits for all rounds must be announced before the competition, and should not be changed after any affected rounds have begun. Changes must be made at the discretion of the WCA Delegate, who must carefully consider the fairness of the change.

The decision was made to keep the time limit as 12 minutes cumulative, referencing [A1a3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1a3) to make the decision. Considering the Delegate announced a higher time limit before the round, it is completely fair to use that time limit.

translation.title: 代表无意中更改盲拧轮次时限
translation.content:
三阶盲拧某轮开始前，代表向选手演示盲拧流程，期间误称累计时限为 **12 分钟**，而比赛网站写的是 **10 分钟**。轮次开始后才意识到错误。

一名选手前两次 DNF，第三次成功，但累计时间超过 10 分钟、少于 12 分钟。

相关规则 A1a3：
> 各轮时限必须赛前公布，受影响轮次开始后不应更改。变更由代表酌情决定，并须谨慎考虑公平性。

最终依据 [A1a3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#A1a3)，决定保留 12 分钟累计时限。代表在轮次开始前公布了较高时限，因此使用该时限完全公平。
